channel.title: One Room, One Check
channel.description:
Short episodes that walk you through one quick home safety check per room: smoke alarms, trip hazards, cords, kitchens and stairs. General information; for anything electrical, structural or urgent, contact a qualified professional.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of RoomMend: Safer Home Plans, an iPhone app to spot something in a room and turn it into a simple, safer plan. RoomMend: Safer Home Plans on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.
